decision: A conditional worth for one separately source-reviewed declared body/shoe metadata map; no observer execution admitted
usable_deliverable: A named source-ownership worksheet: exact default-scene nodes/mesh primitives, skin-to-joint references, literal transforms and POSITION/index/bind accessor descriptors for the pinned body and shoes01 files. It can nominate or refuse a declared g050 foot-reference route before any source-surface study.
bounded_question: Does shoes01 supply an unambiguous declared skin/joint/accessor route usable as a future original foot-reference lead alongside the pinned body, or must that lead remain missing/ambiguous? Descriptors cannot prove bind-world or foot-surface correspondence.

findings.observation: The manifest calls these plumbing stand-ins, declares only g050, and names shoes01 as Low shoes in FOOTWEAR/FEET with a g050 fragment. The GLBs have only been byte-hashed in this review; their node/skin/accessor ownership is not observed here.
findings.explanation: The known manifest resolves the product slot, but not the shoe source owner or joint/accessor route. That literal metadata question is a distinct, finite input decision. A shared g050 filename is not correspondence evidence.

alternatives.A: Read the two pinned container/JSON declarations once and preserve complete named metadata/ambiguity operands
alternatives.tradeoff: Can make a later reference-source nomination precise without geometry evaluation; actual positions, weights, bind values, fit and posed correspondence remain unqualified.

alternatives.B: Defer metadata and wait for a complete original metric footwear source/interface contract
alternatives.tradeoff: Avoids an intermediate worksheet, but leaves the existing shoe owner/frame route unknown and cannot responsibly infer it from names.

findings.witness: ankle-boot-design-proposal/RESULT.json lines 5, 8, 24-27 and 41-55; ROOT-CLOSE.json lines 3, 12-15; manifest lines 160-175
findings.observation: The complete boot proposal has readable brown shaft/heel/counter language, but perspective and no editable or foot-interface authority. Existing Low shoes are not that newly authored ankle boot.
findings.explanation: This map is worthwhile only as declared source input ownership, not as boot selection, reuse or an automatic constructor. The completed raster cannot fill the missing surface interface.

alternatives.A: Keep any metadata lead explicitly scoped to the original g050 body/shoe reference and require fresh full-surface/frame responsibility before boot authorship
alternatives.tradeoff: Preserves a concrete route to future source work without claiming target conformity or physical equivalence.

alternatives.B: Retain the completed boot art and move to another outstanding character/wardrobe goal
alternatives.tradeoff: Conserves metadata effort while the footwear source decision stays open; no raster tuning or source-query retry follows.

precise_stop: Fresh complete controller/source/root/critic admission and a finite deadline precede one metadata observer. First malformed, unsupported or ambiguous declared-owner refusal stops with retained input/partial operands, no repair/retry or broader lookup. Record literal descriptors only; no vertex, weight, index/topology, morph or animation buffer decoding, world/skin arithmetic, import, pose, geometry reuse or fit claim.
limits: No complete new boot source, anatomical foot partition, bind/world equality, g100/masculine-target transfer, topology, material, wearable fit, motion, accepted/default/checklist or AAA qualification. Existing full-body authority does not by itself own shoes01. Any official spec read and later producer remain separately admitted; the closed wellies/raster/runtime methods remain closed.
next: The exact metadata experiment is worth preparing at this narrow declared-source scope. No execution or subsequent surface/constructor study inherits this verdict.
